propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is read into cfg.private_key by OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() but never removed from os.environ, leaving the raw PEM accessible to child processes and environment dumps for the process lifetime
Subprocess children spawned after config load (ssh-keygen, git) inherit REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY from os.environ since they do not receive an explicit env parameter
The inline-PEM path is secondary to the deployed production path which uses REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH, making this a hygiene fix for dev/compat usage rather than a live exposure fix
_private_key_env() must pop the environment variable after capturing it so the secret is transferred into the config object rather than copied
OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() is invoked exactly once at module scope by app.py:171 with no reload or multi-worker paths today, so consume-once semantics can be pinned by test
The read must remain as os.environ.get() with a literal key for gen_env_registry.py to recognize it; the pop must be a separate statement to preserve registry detection
